facts.title: 50th Anniversary (2026)
facts.body: The year 2026 marks alt rock's 50th anniversary, calculated from its starting point in 1976. "Anyway, that makes 2026, which is when I put this series together, alt rocks 50th anniversary."
facts.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
facts.episode: The 50 Biggest Alt-Rock One-Hit Wonders of All Time: Part 2 (40-31)
facts.name: Alt-rock

facts.title: Fourth Decade and Resilience (2026)
facts.body: By 2026, Blink 182 was actively performing and showing no signs of slowing down, entering their fourth decade as a band. Despite numerous past challenges where things threatened to "break down completely," the members consistently managed to pull it back together. "Blink 182 is now into their fourth decade."
facts.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
facts.name: blink‐182

facts.title: Return of Gang and Agorazein (2026)
facts.body: Both Gang and Agorazein, described as opposing pillars of this story, are preparing their return for 2026. This comeback has reportedly awakened a brutal nostalgia for those unfiltered years. "Por gang y agora Cain, los dos pilares opuestos de esta historia, preparan su vuelta para este 2026, y de repente se ha despertado una nostalgia brutal por esos años sin filtros."
facts.episode: La salvaje historia del TRAP ESPAÑOL (2013-2026)
